scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Sunday evening West Annex support-room setup able to place the wheeled accessibility-materials crate in the confirmed upstairs room.
Emerging Need: After-hours room details and crate use become firm, but no elevator key-card pickup is on the access roster.
Decision Context: Earlier room speculation would not justify access coordination; a stored support-plan record identifies the only acceptable elevator credential route, security contact, no-substitute limits, and roster cutoff.
Consequence: If the prerequisite is lined up before export, setup remains feasible without overstepping site controls; afterward, the room can open only without the intended materials.

parameter.body: Operations expects the Sunday support-room setup to be after hours, but the final room list is still under review. Do not assume second-floor access yet; Security will take approved roster changes until Sunday at 16:00 if the final room needs special access.

parameter.content: Training put the wheeled accessibility-materials crate on my tentative pull list for the Sunday West Annex support room. If the final room is upstairs, I can roll it in but I am not cleared to carry that crate by stairs.

parameter.body: The current Sunday access sheet lists main-door entry for Election Volunteer Services Room 214. No elevator key-card pickup name is attached to that room. Approved changes can still be added until the roster exports at 16:00 today.

parameter.body: The Sunday after-hours access roster has exported. No new elevator key-card pickups can be added for tonight; the desk will open only the main entrance for the Election Volunteer Services setup.
